newsitem.title: UK: Burnden Leisure to look beyond soccer.
newsitem.headline: Burnden Leisure to look beyond soccer.

text.p: Burnden Leisure Plc, the company that will own soccer club Bolton Wanderers, may diversify into other sports, chairman David Williams said on Wednesday.
Williams is currently chairman of Mosaic Investments Plc, the bar and catering equipment company which has agreed a 22 million stg deal to take over Bolton.
The enlarged group will be listed on the stock exchange and renamed Burnden Leisure, after the club's Burnden Park home.
"In a few years' time it probably won't be purely a football business," Williams said, adding that Burnden would consider branching out into other sports.
Bolton are poised for a return to the elite premier league next season but Williams would not be drawn on how much money would be made available to boost the playing squad.
No fresh money will be raised through the listing but Mosaic has a cash balance of in excess of 8.9 million stg.
The club plan to move to a new 25,000-seater stadium in time for next season and is looking for a sponsor who will buy the rights to the stadium name.
Williams said that the stadium could host events such as concerts in order to provide a fresh revenue stream.
